<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_ClaimHandling" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/claim-handling">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_ClaimHandling" name="Claim Settlement Recommendation Review" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_ClaimHandling">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_ClaimsOfficer" name="Claims officer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_ClaimRegistered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ExamineClaim</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_WriteSettlementRecommendation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SeniorClaimsOfficer" name="Senior claims officer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckSettlementRecommendation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ClaimOKDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_ClaimHandlingProceeds</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ClaimRegistered" name="Claim registered">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ExamineClaim" name="Examine claim">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_WriteSettlementRecommendation" name="Write settlement recommendation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckSettlementRecommendation" name="Check settlement recommendation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ClaimOKDecision" name="Claim marked OK?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ClaimHandlingProceeds" name="Claim handling proceeds">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_ClaimRegistered" targetRef="Task_ExamineClaim"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_ExamineClaim" targetRef="Task_WriteSettlementRecommendation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_WriteSettlementRecommendation" targetRef="Task_CheckSettlementRecommendation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_CheckSettlementRecommendation" targetRef="Gateway_ClaimOKDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" name="Not OK" sourceRef="Gateway_ClaimOKDecision" targetRef="Task_WriteSettlementRecommendation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" name="OK" sourceRef="Gateway_ClaimOKDecision" targetRef="EndEvent_ClaimHandlingProceeds"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
